description: This file declares the MediaPlayerManager class, which manages media player clients using GStreamer. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, attaching, releasing, and controlling media player clients, and maintains internal state and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: MediaPlayerManager
classes.description: Manages media player clients, providing creation, attachment, release, and control functionalities.

methods.name: getMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the current media player client.

methods.name: attachMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Attaches a media player client to a specified GstObject parent with optional maximum video dimensions.

methods.name: releaseMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Releases the current media player client.

methods.name: hasControl
methods.description: Checks if the manager currently has control over a media player client.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Creates a new media player client with specified parent and video dimensions.

methods.name: acquireControl
methods.description: Attempts to acquire control over a media player client.
